points.title: My Points
points.intro: Every point here has a clear reason — you can explain any of them without asking anyone.
points.balance: {count, plural, =0 {Your balance is zero points} one {Your balance is one point} other {Your balance is {value} points}}
points.empty: No points yet. Your first check-in earns your first point.

catalogue.heading: What earns points?
catalogue.intro: This table is read live from your organisation's settings — a changed value shows here immediately.
catalogue.cap: {count, plural, =0 {No per-session cap} one {Once per session} other {{value} times per session}}
catalogue.pointsValue: {count, plural, =0 {zero points} one {one point} other {{value} points}}

admin.title: Points settings
admin.intro: Change values whenever you like — a change applies only to what is earned afterward, and never rewrites anyone's past balance.

companyRules.heading: Company points
companyRules.intro: Three company-level rules on top of its members' points: hosting sessions, attendance share, and presenting share. Each rule is evaluated once, when a session completes.
companyRules.pointsPerPercent: Points per percentage point of participation share
companyRules.minActiveMembers: Minimum active members for the rule to apply

hostForm.heading: Assign a session's hosting company
hostForm.intro: Enter a session ID and choose its hosting company — a stopgap form until the scheduling screen gets its own field.

manual.heading: Manual adjustment
manual.intro: Add or remove points for a member, with a reason that appears in their history.
